documented_probe: C-27dd85fb (emit alert and report json with the required schemas): covering task at medium difficulty; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases (schema-key assertions, level-boundary scanning, defaults for malformed rules, zero-threshold firing, multi-client lines, garbage rule sets, empty logs).
notes: Single-stage: build a general log-triage program applying literal-keyword + min-level rules to multiple log files and emitting an alert.json (timestamp + id/severity/matches/ips) and a report.json (events + per-rule statistics map). Differs from umber-summit Stage 1: literal substring keywords instead of regex patterns, severity-ordered level gate instead of unconditional matching, client= tokens instead of src=, explicit output-path arguments instead of fixed paths, and a schema-asserting verifier. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (level ordering + defaults), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (malformed lines/rules, multiple hidden cases), quantitative_correctness (exact counts and sorted ip lists). No tool breadth, no dependency chain; totals bucket to medium.
